description: Repository-specific requirements for the Ask Discord assistant.

dos: Ask provides answers, web searches, and image generation through the /ask command, and supports message mentions, replies, direct messages, localized help, and available recent channel context.
Ask requires DISCORD_CLIENT_ID, DISCORD_TOKEN, and OPENAI_API_KEY before it can connect to Discord or answer requests.
Keep command definitions, handlers, event behavior, supported intents, and required permissions aligned with the root README and the Discord application implementation.
donts: Do not document or request Discord intents or permissions that the application does not use.
Do not commit runtime credentials or deploy the bot as part of validation.
